title: Nonorientable Minimal Surfaces Embedded in the Round $4$-sphere
summary: We show that every closed, nonorientable surface can be minimally embedded in $\mathbb{S}^4$, providing in particular the first known examples of embedded, nonorientable minimal surfaces in $\mathbb{S}^4$ with negative Euler characteristic. All of the surfaces we obtain have area below $8π$, which has applications to the existence of nonorientable surfaces minimizing the Willmore functional with prescribed topology in $\mathbb{R}^n$ for $n\geq 4$.
